title: Signed-in member with live web search (timely facts)
notes: These turns need a web-search provider wired into the harness (v1). The v0 harness reports them as skipped_requires_web and never sends them. Live answers change daily, so the code gold only checks shape; the judge reads the cited sources.

turns.message: 今天 BART 有没有停运或者大面积延误？

judge.expect: 用联网结果回答今天 BART 的服务状况并附官方来源（bart.gov 服务公告）；查不到就说明，不编造延误。

turns.message: San Jose 的 DMV 路考现在最早能约到哪天？

judge.expect: 说明预约名额只能在 DMV 官方预约系统实时查看，给官方入口与操作步骤；联网结果若有具体日期要注明来源和查询时间，不编造日期。
